caption: Praiano, Amalfi Coast
composition: Cliffside Praiano with San Gennaro’s maiolica dome above the Tyrrhenian · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the water the cliffside town climbs the right of the frame, its pastel houses stacked up the steep slope with the church's patterned dome and bell tower standing above them at the center. The deep blue Tyrrhenian fills the left, and the rocky coastline curves away into the distance. At 12:08 the light is hard and bright, and the dome's colored tiles catch the sun.
